snippet.title: Abyzou Rituals: The Manson Case | OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Abyzou Rituals: The Manson Case, a corrupted found-footage aesthetic designed to make the experience feel like something recovered rather than created, now available on Steam and Epic Games Store. 

🎮https://store.steampowered.com/app/5295730/Abyzou_Rituals_The_Manson_Case/


Main Features:
• A deeply disturbing psychological-horror experience built around satanic rituals, occult symbolism, forbidden ceremonies, demonic folklore, and sacrifice.
• Explore house 12, the site of a massacre connected to an unfinished ritual.
• Reconstruct a forbidden ceremony through symbols, ritual objects, recordings, and evidence left behind by a vanished cult.
• A corrupted found-footage aesthetic designed to make the experience feel like something recovered rather than created.
• Whispers, distorted audio, infant cries, footsteps, apparitions, and environmental phenomena blur the boundary between the house and the player.
• Observation, quick thinking, and mental resilience are your only weapons.
• The ritual does not begin inside the game. Clicking "Play" is part of it.
• The longer you play, the closer Abyzou gets.

#demonic #darkness #exorcism #horrorgaming #videogames #steam #gaming
